archetypes.name: dyn-agent-prompt-style
archetypes.rationale: Reviewer prompt grammar and generated body sync are the main risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the reviewer prompt edits for correct directive placement and unchanged output grammar. Check generated agents and pre-rendered bodies against their sources. Verify no non-reviewer implementer agents were pulled into the readability lint walk. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
